title: Pick a trace wide enough for the heater
story: A 12 V battery feeds a 6 ohm heater (2 A) through a 200 mm copper trace of 1 oz copper; the return goes through a solid ground plane, which we treat as perfect. Each part in the tray is a trace of a different width, modelled as its resistance: 0.2 mm wide = 0.49 ohm, 1 mm wide = 0.098 ohm, 3 mm wide = 0.033 ohm. The heater needs at least 11.85 V and the trace must not burn more than 0.25 W.

goals.label: the heater gets at least 11.85 V
the trace dissipates at most 0.25 W

hints: R = rho * L / (width * thickness): doubling the width halves the resistance.
The current is about 12 V / (6 ohm + R trace), and the trace heats with I^2 * R.
